# Oswin Ply
> Chennai-headquartered manufacturer of plywood, block board, flush doors, and
> prelaminated particle board. ISI-certified, 25+ years, with a dealer network
> across South India.

## Core products
- [Oswin Ply Club Plywood](https://www.oswinply.com/plywood/oswin-ply-club): premium plywood range
- [Oswin Flush Door](https://www.oswinply.com/doors/oswin-flush-door): flush door manufacturer, specs and details
- [Oswin Block Board](https://www.oswinply.com/block-board/oswin-block-board): block board range
- [Prelam Solids](https://www.oswinply.com/prelam/solids): prelaminated particle boards

## Buying guides
- [Block Board vs Plywood](https://www.oswinply.com/blogs/block-board-vs-plywood): which one to use where

- [Plywood and Laminate Pairing Guide](https://www.oswinply.com/blogs/plywood-laminate-pairing-guide): what to use in kitchens and wardrobes
